import subprocess

# Test 1: Duplicate reference with cache=False - should NOT raise RecursionError
code = r'''
from boltons.iterutils import remap

inner = {'x': 1}
out = remap([inner, inner], cache=False)
print("out:", out)
print("PASS: No error on duplicate reference")
'''
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
print(result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-300:])
